ops.body:
Home cutover MAPPED from source (all cites in the repair thread) and GO given, probe-gated: (0) SSH-probe the box peer from home FIRST — `synckitd host add`'s no-recurse path still resolves the peer's synckitd path over SSH (bootstrap.go:60-68 → RemoteBinaryPath), fail-fast 10s, and the box's Tailscale name showed 100% loss earlier, so this is the one hard gate; if unreachable, nothing is touched. (1) archive all 3 manifests into manifests-pre-v0.36.2-20260726/; (2) host add re-registers the existing peer + writes the v1 envelope (AddHost sets Self, registers only the named target — other peers untouched); (3) `synckitd install` converges daemonkit-owned agents — zero-manifest discovery is clean by design (Discover returns nil,nil on empty/missing dir), legacy same-label plists are boot-out-and-replaced unconditionally (daemonkit service/controller.go:552-561). Then 30-min window vs baseline 1127.

NEW GAP FOUND: **cookiesync is a 12th daemonkit downstream missed by the whole repin wave** — repo yasyf/cookiesync, main pins daemonkit v0.19.1 + synckit v0.35.2, latest release v0.27.2 predates the baseline; machines run 0.17.0. Its main already emits the new manifest shape (SchemaFingerprint), so a repin+release lane is now running (expected v0.27.3: daemonkit→v0.20.6, synckit→v0.36.2, trusted-key tag). Machine cutovers re-register cookiesync via `cookiesync install` only after that release + brew upgrade.
